summary: xAI added a /goal command to Grok Build that lets the coding agent autonomously plan, execute and verify longer implementation tasks with pause/resume/status controls.

mechanisms.reason: A mode that lets the agent run continuously until a task is verified implies more autonomous tool calls and test-time compute per task, though no volume figures are given.
mechanisms.quote: This new mode yields long-running, autonomous execution, helping you hand off larger implementation tasks to the agent.

practices.reason: The goal-directed loop with planning, checklist decomposition, and pause/resume/status controls is a concrete agent-scaffolding pattern a team could study for their own agent design, though no performance gain is quantified.
practices.quote: It plans an approach, breaks the work into a progress checklist, and starts executing. You can keep sharing additional instructions with the agent as it works.
